azure_openai_resource.description: Either a resource name (e.g., 'my-openai-westus3' -> host 'my-openai-westus3.openai.azure.com') or a full host (e.g., 'myres.cognitiveservices.azure.com'). Used to construct https://{host}/openai/deployments/{modelVersion}/chat/completions?api-version={api_version} when 'endpoint_url' is not provided.

api_version.description: Azure OpenAI API version. Use latest stable version for new features.

endpoint_url.description: Optional full URL override for the chat completions endpoint, e.g., 'https://myres.cognitiveservices.azure.com/openai/deployments/__MODEL_VERSION__/chat/completions?api-version=2025-01-01-preview'. If set, this is used directly.

temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

top_p.description: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

API_KEY.description: Azure OpenAI API key from the Azure portal Keys & Endpoint section.
